authority.planning_authority: closes exact K16 dictionary reuse and cross-Gate-Up identical/proportional-code reuse as a material Prefill architecture for the sampled early, middle, and terminal layers of this pinned checkpoint

method.source_format: Safetensors U8 tensors with eight packed E2M1 bytes and one E4M3 block-scale byte per K16 block
method.exact_key: eight packed E2M1 bytes plus the corresponding E4M3 K16 scale byte
method.optimistic_q_only_key: eight packed E2M1 bytes with scale ignored; this is only an upper bound for any proportional-block opportunity
method.within_role_test: count repeated exact and optimistic keys independently for Gate, Up, and Down
method.cross_role_test: count repeated keys over the concatenated Gate and Up inventories when their tensor-global scale bits are identical

decision.reason: Across 50,135,040 authentic MLP role-block instances in early, middle, and terminal layers, every packed E2M1 K16 code block was unique even before its block scale was considered. The combined Gate-plus-Up searches likewise found every one of 33,423,360 optimistic q-only and exact q-plus-scale keys unique. A dictionary, repeated-block cache, or identical/proportional-code cross-role plan therefore has no observed reuse to exploit and cannot remove the order-of-magnitude work required by the P40 target.
decision.scope_boundary: This stratified structural screen does not prove that no duplicate exists anywhere in the remaining 61 layers, and it is not a performance result. Zero duplicates in more than fifty million authentic role blocks is sufficient to reject this mechanism as the next material architecture; it does not authorize a universal mathematical claim about every checkpoint block.
decision.next_step: Do not build or benchmark a K16 dictionary/repeated-block CUDA path. Reconcile the matched production work ledger and pursue only exact work deletion or a complete role-specific dataflow with a credible whole-P40 budget.
